mentions.name: plid
mentions.description: A Postgres extension, built with pgrx, that builds on ULID to add prefixes to generated identifiers. It provides a gen_plid function that returns prefixed ULID-style IDs such as u_06DHRQH6SJT7N2WEQK4910R, with the aim of matching the storage size of a UUID.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Yesterday I built most of a Postgres extension, using the excellent pgrx[1] project, that build on ulid to add prefixes. With it you get something like this

    plid=# SELECT gen_plid('u');
         gen_plid
    ---------------------------
     u_06DHRQH6SJT7N2WEQK4910R
    (1 row)
